zh.title: Spirit Airlines空服員工會反對Google千萬美元數據交易
zh.summary: Spirit Airlines空服員工會入稟破產法院，要求阻止關於其成員的內部數據出售。
body: 代表Spirit Airlines前空服員的Association of Flight Attendants-CWA已入稟美國破產法院，要求阻止或限制Google以一千萬美元收購該公司內部商業數據及軟體。
工會憂慮，載有員工個人資訊的紀錄，包括電郵、Teams訊息及作業紀錄，可能在未獲同意下表利用。
Google表示，個人識別資料將在轉移前移除；工會強調，即使刪除姓名，工作紀錄如排程糾紛、紀律事項及申訴等內容仍屬敏感。
這宗交易仍需待破產法院法官審理及批准。

en.title: Spirit Airlines flight attendants' union challenges Google's $10 million data deal in bankruptcy court
en.summary: Spirit Airlines' cabin crew union asks a bankruptcy court to block Google's $10 million purchase of staff data; union cites privacy concerns.
body: The Association of Flight Attendants-CWA, which represents Spirit Airlines' former cabin crew, has asked a US bankruptcy court to block or restrict the sale of the carrier's internal business data to Google for $10 million.
The union says confidential employee information, including emails, Teams messages and operational records, could be used without crew members' consent.

Google has said personally identifiable information would be removed before the data is transferred, but the union argues that workplace records can remain sensitive even after names are deleted, citing scheduling disputes, disciplinary matters and training problems.
The sale still requires approval by the bankruptcy court.
